purpose: Records all Blotato carousel render test results for FirstDropHQ POC evaluation

creditEstimateRows.note: Appended below render test rows when workflow completes the loop

qualityReviewInstructions.step1: After workflow runs, open the outputUrl for each template
qualityReviewInstructions.step2: Fill in visualQualityNotes with detailed observations
qualityReviewInstructions.step3: Set isPremiumLook to YES / NO / MARGINAL
qualityReviewInstructions.step4: Set recommendation to USE / FALLBACK / ADJUST
qualityChecklist: Ticker/badge elements visible (e.g. OKLO, DATA, HOOK)
No cheap clip-art or stock photo meme aesthetic
Brand name FirstDropHQ present on final slide
Consistent visual theme across all 8 slides

fallbackDecisionCriteria.useBlotato: If both templates score isPremiumLook=YES and style matches Bloomberg dark aesthetic
fallbackDecisionCriteria.useFallback: If Blotato cannot produce premium dark finance look — switch to: HTML/CSS template → Puppeteer screenshot → PNG URL → Blotato scheduler
fallbackDecisionCriteria.fallbackStack: Custom HTML slide → headless Chrome/Puppeteer render → cloud storage PNG URL → Blotato Create Post with media_url
